reasoning.description: Opt-in reasoning / extended-thinking controls. Accepts Fastino's normalized shape with keys ``enabled`` (bool), ``max_tokens`` (int, Anthropic-style budget), ``effort`` (one of minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max/none, OpenAI-style tier), and ``exclude`` (bool, hide reasoning tokens from the response). ``effort`` and ``max_tokens`` are mutually exclusive. Fastino extensions for Claude routes (Anthropic direct + Bedrock): ``mode`` (manual/adaptive — adaptive lets the model pick thinking depth per request, required on Opus 4.7+) and ``display`` (summarized/omitted — controls whether thinking text streams back; omitted preserves only the signature for multi-turn). On Chat Completions, provider reasoning text is hidden by default and is returned on ``message.reasoning_content`` / ``delta.reasoning_content`` only when the caller explicitly requests visible reasoning with ``exclude=false`` or ``display=summarized``. Fastino normalizes this into one reasoning setting and each provider renders it to its native wire field (Anthropic ``thinking``, OpenAI ``reasoning_effort``, Vercel AI Gateway ``reasoning``). Fastino does not enable reasoning by default.

schema.description: Schema for the Fastino encoder (GLiNER models). A decoder model refuses it with a 400; send a JSON Schema in ``response_format`` for structured output. **Deprecated when supplied as a flat list** of entity labels; use the unified dict shape (``entities`` / ``classifications`` / ``structures`` / ``relations``) instead. Deprecated submissions emit ``Deprecation: true`` and ``Sunset: <RFC 7231 date>`` headers. Record modes (``natural``, ``latent``, ``anchorless``) are hosted when ``encoder_features`` includes ``records``, which ``fastino/gliner2.5-multi-v1`` does. ``mode``, ``anchor``, ``occurrence_policy``, and field ``cardinality`` return 400 on any other encoder. Span attributes (``entity_attributes``) are hosted when ``encoder_features`` includes ``span_attributes``, which ``fastino/gliner2.5-multi-v1`` does. Constrained classification (``version``, ``tasks``, ``constraints``) is hosted when ``encoder_features`` includes ``constrained_classification``, which ``fastino/gliner2.5-multi-v1`` does. JointIE (``constraints`` without ``tasks`` or ``version``, and relation ``head`` / ``tail`` options) is hosted when ``encoder_features`` includes ``joint_ie``, which ``fastino/gliner2.5-multi-v1`` does. Read ``encoder_features`` on ``GET /v1/base-models``.

'off' trains every entity and classification task on its full declared label set, in order, under its real names: suited to a fixed label set. It also stops renaming JSON-structure fields to placeholders (the library shares that setting); structure and field dropping, relations and task order keep their sampling. get.description:
List base models available to the caller.

Each model reports its inference and training capabilities, supported
training types, context limits, and public pricing. Capability filters
select models currently available for the requested operation.

Authentication is optional. Anonymous callers receive the public catalog;
authenticated callers may also receive models available to their account.
Model visibility can vary by account eligibility and jurisdiction.

Examples:
    GET /v1/base-models                          — full catalog
    GET /v1/base-models?supports_inference=true   — serverless-capable models
    GET /v1/base-models?supports_training=true    — trainable models
    GET /v1/base-models?task_type=encoder          — encoder/NER models only
    GET /v1/base-models?task_type=decoder          — decoder/LLM models only
    GET /v1/base-models?task_type=embedding        — text embedding models only
